statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the only discoverable endpoint. The site returns an empty body for the homepage and no additional valid archetypes were discoverable.

paths.description: Homepage and only discoverable archetype; tested as the public entry point. Also probed robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and a nonexistent path for indexing and recovery. No other pages, links, forms, sitemap URLs, manifest shortcuts, or flows existed to cover.

findings.evidence: The server returns a zero-byte body and the rendered DOM has zero text, headings, landmarks, links, controls, or forms. Desktop and crawler screenshots are blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve meaningful HTML that states the site purpose and exposes a clear primary action.

findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, computed color-scheme remains normal and the screenshot keeps the default blank light canvas.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark"> and :root { color-scheme: light dark }, then theme authored surfaces.

findings.summary: The mobile viewport is not configured
findings.evidence: At a 360px device width, Chrome creates a 980px layout viewport and scales it to 0.367 because meta viewport is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and use intrinsic, fluid layout.

findings.summary: Error and recovery states are misleading
findings.evidence: A deliberately nonexistent route returns HTTP 200 and the text "empty OK"; the homepage gives no status or recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Return the correct 404 status with a clear not-found message and links back to useful content; provide actionable failure states.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse aborts with NO_FCP, and the trace records null FCP and LCP despite a completed load.
findings.suggestedFix: Return paintable semantic HTML immediately, then progressively enhance it; remeasure LCP, INP, and CLS.

findings.summary: The document has no semantic structure
findings.evidence: The DOM has zero headings and zero landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 and semantic main/nav/header/footer landmarks matching the information hierarchy.

findings.summary: The response is not an authored HTML document
findings.evidence: The root response is zero bytes with Content-Type application/octet-stream; there is no doctype or charset and Chrome falls back to windows-1252.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve text/html containing <!doctype html> and <meta charset="utf-8">.

findings.evidence: The title is empty and meta description is absent in both raw and rendered inspection.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique descriptive title and concise meta description reflecting visible page content.

findings.summary: Crawler and mobile discovery basics are missing
findings.evidence: There are no anchors or viewport meta, and robots.txt contains "empty OK" rather than valid directives.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid robots.txt, add a viewport meta, and expose important navigation as descriptive href links.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are malformed or absent
findings.evidence: No canonical exists, sitemap.xml is not XML, and arbitrary nonexistent routes return 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a valid XML sitemap, canonical URLs, and accurate HTTP status codes, including 404 for missing pages.

findings.summary: Share and entity metadata are absent
findings.evidence: The public homepage contains zero Open Graph fields and zero JSON-LD blocks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and appropriate schema.org JSON-LD after meaningful visible content exists.

findings.summary: Baseline transport security headers are absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS is active, but CSP, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforced CSP, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; test CSP in report-only mode first.

findings.evidence: No X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), a strict Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: No core content exists with or without JavaScript
findings.evidence: The raw response is zero bytes and the rendered DOM is also empty; browser and crawler screenshots are both blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core semantic content and links, using JavaScript only as progressive enhancement.

findings.evidence: The html element has empty lang and dir values.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an accurate BCP 47 lang value on html and use logical CSS properties as content is added.
